ticket.subject: Prorated refund for plan change
ticket.body_text:
Hi folks,

Writing on behalf of Brambleway Studio. After switching down to the Starter plan, we expected a prorated credit, but invoice INV-2026-3903 shows the old Business plan price.

The plan page in the settings shows the new plan correctly.

Can you apply the prorated credit to our next invoice?

Many thanks,
Leila
